'''Sarapin Four''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Sarapin system/Legends|Sarapin system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] ''[[Enkindle]]'' retreated to the upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of Sarapin Four, but was [[Battle of Sarapin Four|destroyed]] by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial forces]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=space|Sarapin Assault}}</ref>
